checks.message: All applicable intake answers compile into a deterministic modular report design.
Read-only GET /v3/reporting/cost/run definitions were generated; execution is not implied.
Every required field has a synthetic candidate binding; target-tenant confirmation remains required.
External inputs remain required for: budget, forecast.
Additional source requirements are defined, but inputs, integration, grain checks, freshness, and reconciliation remain unconfirmed.
Every module and selected comparison baseline has an explicit deterministic ranking plan.
Alert trigger, delivery, cooldown, resolution, and escalation requirements are recorded; manual configuration, testing, and approval remain required.
The generated package has no Cloudability View, API, or alert write authority.

findings.message: Synthetic candidate bindings do not prove that fields exist in a target tenant.
The target tenant has not confirmed that the bound provider field uses the exact AWS literal required by the filter.
Automated saved-report creation is unverified; View writes are intentionally disabled in this runtime.
Budget AWS-only scope, source, columns, grain, currency, and reconciliation require manual confirmation.
Forecast AWS-only scope, source, columns, grain, currency, and reconciliation require manual confirmation.
Additional source inputs and integration are not configured; join coverage, grain, cadence, owner, and reconciliation require manual confirmation.
Requested alerts require separate manual configuration, testing, and activation approval.
